reconcile.note: Gill limits 1 Corinthians' believeth all things to charitable trust in people's character, not to credulity about words or claimed spirits.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells, The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (1999 (site); 2013 (print ed.)).

sides.snippet: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
sides.verseText: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.

sides.snippet: Beloved, don't believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
